annotations.title: Export a data layer to a file

description: Use when the user wants a whole data layer as a file (GeoJSON or CSV) for their own analysis. Exports one layer from list_export_layers, optionally clipped to a bbox and filtered, and returns a presigned download URL, the row count and a small preview. Large layers (for example drillholes, 3.46M rows) require a bbox. inspect_point and get_geochem summarise around a point; this tool returns the rows themselves.

bbox.description: [west, south, east, north] lon/lat clip (required for huge layers).

layer.description: One of the layers from list_export_layers.

limit.description: Cap the rows (<= the layer's max).

name: export_data
title: Export a data layer to a file
